\begin{figure*}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/fig_example.pdf}
  \caption{One Qiskit program under each dependence rule. (a)~The program; the comment on each line names
  the operation it creates. (b)~The dependences of $q_0$, the operations where a change can alter
  $q_0$'s state. (c)--(e)~The slice of $q_0$ that each rule computes, with the source lines it keeps and
  its fidelity at $\ket{000}$ and at 20 random product inputs. Def-use misses the kickback through $o_4$;
  entanglement closure adds $o_0$, which cannot affect $q_0$; the wire rule keeps exactly the dependences.
  (f)~State-based pruning of $q_2$ at $\ket{000}$ is exact at that input but drops three dependences and is
  wrong at all 20 random inputs. Slices, dependences and verdicts are computed by the study's code from
  the program in~(a).}
